text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions (Non-Employee) Order. Person declared not to be employee

The person or class of persons specified in the Schedule are hereby declared not to be an employee or employees for the purposes of the Order.

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)
Member of the Royal Brunei Police Force who is employed on the pensionable establishment.
Prison officer who is employed on the pensionable establishment.

Any person who receives a monthly pension by virtue of the provisions of any law governing the grant of such pension on the services as a public officer, a member of the Royal Brunei Armed Forces, a member of the Royal Brunei Police Force or a prison officer.
